## Use case / 使用场景

Describe the task that is difficult today.

## Expected behavior / 预期行为

Include concrete inputs/outputs and the supported hardware/model involved.

## Validation / 验收方式

Explain how to check correctness, usability or measured performance. Do not attach private prompts, credentials or model files.
